events.description: 17. ORDER. The parties have submitted a motion to voluntarily dismiss the instant action with prejudice at ECF No. 16, whereby they jointly inform having reached a private settlement agreement between themselves. Given plaintiffs' stated intent to withdraw the claims originally raised and the joint request for dismissal, there is no need for the Court to entertain the issues raised nor to approve the agreement as no Court order is necessary for the dismissal to take effect. Fed. R. Civ. P. 41(a)(1)(A)(ii); see also 9 Fed. Prac. & Proc. Civ. § 2363 ("A voluntary dismissal by stipulation under Rule 41(a)(1)(A)(ii) is effective immediately upon filing and does not require judicial approval; the reason for the dismissal stipulation is irrelevant.") (collecting authorities). Accordingly, plaintiffs' motion at ECF No. 16 is NOTED and the case is hereby DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE. The Clerk of Court shall enter Judgment accordingly. Signed by Judge Aida M. Delgado-Colon on 7/12/2024. (wm) (Entered: 07/12/2024)
